2609.20034.title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
2609.20034.paper_summary: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.
2609.20034.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Astronex-World 1.0，一個可控的開放視頻世界模型基礎。根據文本提示（文本到視頻）或初始觀察（圖像到視頻），該模型在幀對齊的相機軌跡、連續動作和具身識別符下預測未來的視覺狀態，並接受在回放的指定位置插入的文本事件。該家族提供了一個雙向模型以進行全上下文生成，以及一個具有塊因果注意力和跨塊 KV 緩存的因果模型以進行持續生成，兩者均基於 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 先驗。PRoPE 注入相機內部參數和外部參數，而一個 64 維的動作流調節每個 Transformer 層。一個五階段的訓練路徑發展雙向相機和動作控制，將主幹轉換為塊因果生成，提煉幾步學生，恢復混合域動態，並應用不對稱 DMD/DMD2 分佈匹配。因果模型以 24 fps 生成 832x480 的視頻。所有五個訓練階段在兩個 NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU 上運行，而因果模型在一個上實時流式傳輸。它在 WBench Navi 上得分 73.5，在 WBench Full 上得分 70.0。在 Full 上，這個 5B 模型超過了 13.6B LongCat-Video 和 14B Helios，與 22B LTX-2.3 相差一分，並且高於 YUME 1.5，該模型是在同一 5B 先驗上於 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上進行後訓練的。保留的動作輸入和輸出接口允許具身智能和自主駕駛的後訓練。
